name: steps
useFor: Use for a fixed sequence of stages ("Parcel, Power, Water, Report"). Pass the labels and `current`, the stage in progress; `steps.length` means all done. Labels reach half their width past the row's ends, so leave room, or use `labelAlign="edges"`. When `current` moves on, the finished node stamps, the line travels and the next node lights on arrival.
constraints: Clickable steps; this shows progress, not navigation
title: Steps
description: Survey nodes joined by a line: the stages of a run, done, current and pending.
